sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Back: it looks ahead now, away from you. The head is drawn from behind: no eye in sight, the muzzle shorter and lifted a little. The head turned back toward the trainer is kept as its own animation, Look back (in the animation list): the idle, with the head turned back for about three seconds of each loop. Nothing else changed.

note: Twelfth look. Delta Charizard's back now looks ahead; the look back at the trainer is kept as an animation.
